messages:
Nina: Quick health ping for Qorex onboarding (past 7d). Primary ask: p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming. Short summary up top: streaming p95 ~240ms (+12% w/w), p99 ~660ms (+24%). non-streaming p95 ~310ms (-5%), p99 ~940ms (+4%). Error rate rose to 0.14% (mostly /chat-stream). Spend steady.

Raj: Digging into route split now. Live dashboard: <https://redwood.prod/dash/qorex/latency?range=7d&breakdown=route,model>

Tom: Saw spike yesterday 02:10 UTC. A few streams aborted and retried as syncs from the clientstack. Customer reported duplicated messages on retry.

Nina: Traces show the worst-tail streaming requests are hitting `mistral-7b-stream` on /chat-stream when there are long tool-call prefixes. non-streaming heavy tail coming from `llama13b-v2` on /complete with large batch windows.

Raj: Query I used (repro):
```
SELECT route, model, mode, percentile(latency_ms,95) AS p95, percentile(latency_ms,99) AS p99, sum(errors) as errs
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE org_id = 'qorex' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route, model, mode
ORDER BY p99 DESC
```
Outputs show /chat-stream + mistral-7b-stream p99 >> other combos.

CS-Bot: Alert triggered: /chat-stream p99 exceeded 600ms threshold. Incident created (#INC-629).

Evelyn: Qorex PM: customers prefer no partial duplications. If fallback to sync, they want a single consistent completion. Please flag any UX changes before roll.

Nina: Root suspects we have: (a) cache misses for long prefixed sessions on pool-4 causing KV fetchs over network; (b) stream-optimized kernel stalls under 250 concurrent streams; (c) occasional oversized batching coalescence.

Tom: Proposed short-term steps:
- Canary 15% of /chat-stream traffic -> `mistral-7b-sync` for requests with estimated tokens >= 800.
- Temporarily lower max batch size for stream pool (pool-4) from 48 -> 32 for 6h.
- Increase prefix KV cache TTL and prewarm for top-20 prefixes.

Nina: Canary config (will run limited 6h window):
```
route: /chat-stream
canary: {
  percent: 15,
  condition: request.estimated_tokens >= 800,
  fallback_model: "mistral-7b-sync",
  window_secs: 21600
}
```
Canary start planned: 2445560000 (UTC). Will watch p95/p99, error rate, and dup-report events.

Raj: Before canary, I'll collect baseline histograms and set temporary dashboards: p95/p99 per model+route, error-rate by error_type, duplicate retries count.

Evelyn: I'll draft an email to Qorex PM to outline expected UX (sync fallback: single completion, slight latency increase) and ask them to surface any regressions.

Tom: Notes on measurement: look at request.local_queue_ms to detect large batch waits, and kernel_wait_ms for stream kernels. If kernel_wait spikes align with p99, escalate to runtime infra for kernel hotfix.

Nina: Action list: 
- Nina: kick off canary at 2445560000, monitor tail metrics and customer dup reports.
- Raj: create dashboards + post baseline graphs (p95/p99 hist) before canary.
- Tom: apply temporary batch size limit on pool-4 and bump KV TTL + prewarm scripts.
- Evelyn: notify Qorex PM and ask for user-observed logs.

Tom: I'll also enable additional sampling of stream traces (increase sampling rate from 0.5% -> 3%) for the canary window.

CS-Bot: Reminder scheduled: canary (Nina) at 2445560000. Incident #INC-629 is open.

Nina: Follow-up sync Friday morning to confirm whether p99 improves below 600ms. If not, we'll create repro jobs and request infra kernel dive. :white_check_mark:
